key_insight: The paper generalizes proximal linearized block updates to arbitrary inner-product geometries, improving how multiblock nonconvex nonsmooth problems are solved.
engineering_relevance: This lets optimization algorithms match the problem’s geometry more closely, which can improve numerical efficiency in large-scale engineering and data science applications.
method: Define a generalized geometry proximal linearized operator using arbitrary inner products and admissible metrics.
Build the GGBPL method and an inertial variant (iGGBPL) for multiblock updates.
Prove convergence, global convergence to a critical point, and an O(epsilon^-2) complexity bound.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical tests on sparse nonnegative matrix factorization and sparse nonnegative CP decomposition with l0-constraints, showing superior performance versus several state-of-the-art methods.
watch_item: Performance gains may depend on choosing a suitable geometry/metric for each problem, so implementation requires careful metric design and tuning.
paper_title: Generalized Geometry Block Proximal Linearized Method for Multiblock Nonconvex and Nonsmooth Optimization
